layout_sources: https://github.com/wimverstuyf/php-belgianbankstatement-parser/blob/master/tests/Samples/sample4_kbc.csv (the 18-column header word for word; padded Afschriftnummer, blank credit/debet cells as 14 spaces, newest first)
https://github.com/plenaerts/ofxstatement-be-kbc (18 fields; first data line is the most recent and carries the end balance)
https://github.com/matthiasvalvekens/kbc-gnucash-import (semicolon; Datum dd/mm/yyyy; Bedrag parsed by swapping the comma for a point, so no thousands mark)
notes: KBC Touch CSV export: one header row, semicolon-separated, unquoted, dates dd/mm/yyyy, signed Bedrag with a comma decimal and no thousands mark, Saldo the balance after each line, newest first. The credit/debet columns repeat the amount on the matching side and hold 14 spaces on the other (whether debet is printed signed is not confirmed; here it repeats the signed Bedrag). Empty structured-message cells are 35 spaces. LF line ends as in the sample; encoding unconfirmed (content kept ASCII). Closing = the newest line's Saldo; opening = the oldest line's Saldo minus its amount.
